statement: In each of the 9 PolyPythias pythia-410m-seed{1..9} runs, the energy break (the first of the 18 grid steps at which the layer-monotonicity violations of E_1, summed over the 7 v1 prompts, reach half their median over steps 1000, 2000 and 4000) is step 256 or 512. Seeds 3 and 4, PolyPythias's named outliers, count and are flagged.
h0: The break's step is the run's: across seeds it falls anywhere among the 12 non-zero grid steps up to 4000, each with probability 1/12, independently.
test_name: exact one-sided binomial tail P(Bin(9, 1/6) >= K), K = seeds whose energy break is step 256 or 512 (trackA_force.a5_seeds:p_value_p_a5)

run_manifest.rescored: 2026-10-20: score re-run from the 9 seeds' records (hashes equal to the audit's); K, p, E, per-seed readings identical

notes: First ledger record (STATE Blocked 78 (a), the user's, 2026-10-20). A reproducibility check, not a test of mechanism (design-A5.md D9 (a)): E is against a uniform-location null nobody holds (D6 (b)), so a large E is cheap; relevance is the registry's floor (0.6); all 9 seeds share Pythia's LR warmup (to about step 1430), so K = 9 says the step is the recipe's, not whether it is training's or the schedule's. H-RESIST's reject_null after this record rests on this entry alone; every quote of that decision carries this line.
